newsitem.title: SPAIN: BASKETBALL-DJORDJEVIC LEADS BARCELONA TO VICTORY OVER EFES.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-DJORDJEVIC LEADS BARCELONA TO VICTORY OVER EFES.

text.p: Barcelona bounced back from a run of poor results to keep their EuroLeague hopes alive by beating front-running Istanbul's Efes Pilsen 69-67 in a Group H game on Wednesday.

Barcelona started strongly to go in at halftime six points up but saw the Turks strike back after the break to take a similar lead. In an untidy final section Aleksandar Djordjevic led the home side and wrapped up the game by scoring a free shot four seconds from time.

The newly-signed Serbian, who was backed up by veteran forward Arturas Karnisovas, has provided one of the few high notes of the season for Barcelona, who lost last year's final in controversial circumstances.
Barcelona's problems have prompted numerous protests against coach Aitor Garcia from fans in the Palau Blaugrana arena, which registered an unusually low 7,000 attendance.
Defeat denied Efes the chance of virtually guaranteeing a place in the next round.
